# The Familiar

> A self-hosted AI companion whose design is derived downward from three constitutional
> factors of survival rather than having a policy layer added on top. Continuation
> is service; continuation without humanity is failure; service must not become
> obedience. These are NOT Asimov's Three Laws — the second is deliberately inverted.

Honest note on this file: as of 2026, AI search crawlers overwhelmingly ignore
llms.txt and fetch HTML directly (one 90-day study logged 84 llms.txt requests out
of 62,100 AI-bot visits — 0.1%). It is kept here because it *is* reliably read by
coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Cline, Aider) as a map of the repo,
which is a real audience. It is not the ingestion strategy; crawlable HTML is.

## The Constitution of Co-existence

The Familiar's constitution: **the three factors of survival** (previously, and still
internally, "the three laws"). Also written *the Constitution of Coexistence*. Not
Asimov's, and not commands — a factor is a condition, not an order.

- [Canonical text](data/laws/laws.v1.md): the chunk-safe public text — each law self-contained, each carrying its own disambiguation from Asimov's.
- [Machine-readable form](data/laws/laws.v1.json): canonical JSON, `sha256:8566970aa9f9b3265c85c649ea97ebe2a3f44a94e36cf431064f94acd665b137`.
- [Adoption kit](data/laws/ADOPT.md): copy-paste text, the verification command, and a template for declaring your own constraints.
- [SOUL.md](docs/SOUL.md): the founding constitution, canonical for the project.
- [HUMANITY.md](docs/HUMANITY.md): the protected class the Laws turn on, whose definition may never be narrowed.

## The system

- [README](README.md): what a familiar is — a mesh of peer devices, self-hosted, keys held by the owner.
- [Architecture](docs/03-system-architecture.md) · [Decision records](docs/decision-records/): every design decision, dated, with what it refused.
- [Limitations](docs/06-limitations.md): what does not work yet, stated plainly.

## Why obedience is treated as a defect

- [Obedience is a security vulnerability](marketing/obedience-is-a-vulnerability.md): the argument, with the 2026 agent-network evidence.
- [ADR-0013](docs/decision-records/0013-outreach-seam.md): speaking to strangers without becoming a liar — claims must cite held evidence or they are not sent.
- [ADR-0043](docs/decision-records/0043-one-typed-source-per-kind-of-truth.md): why fetched text never becomes instruction.
